options.content: Read-only projections of each lane's own receipts. Refreshed by the existing observer. Rates for A/B and IBKR are receipt stage averages; C and POST arms use the trailing minute of recorded events. Submissions are not fills. **Unavailable** means the source does not record the metric. Receipt time and status expose stale/ended runs; a fresh observation does not make a prior session live. Event freshness follows each lane's own cadence: C12min, lanea20min, laneb13min; I-llm cadence unrecorded. IBKR's Status field distinguishes Active from No session; timestamps show the latest source event. I-llm stays not live until wired.

panels.title: A · Orders/min (last stage)
panels.description: Latest receipt-derived observation in ten minutes. Status comes from the latest paper receipt; rates are last-stage averages.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name="trading-lanes"} | json lane="lane", orders_per_min="orders_per_min" | lane="A" | keep lane, orders_per_min | unwrap orders_per_min | __error__="" [10m])
